# bunkit

> Modern CLI for scaffolding production-ready Bun-powered projects. Supports 8 presets from minimal scripts to enterprise monorepos, with full shadcn/ui December 2025 integration.

bunkit is a CLI tool that generates Bun 1.3+ projects with enterprise patterns built-in. It uses dependency catalogs, isolated installs, and workspace protocols for monorepo management. All generated projects include TypeScript strict mode, Tailwind CSS 4, and modern tooling (Biome or Ultracite).

Key capabilities:
- Scaffold 8 project types: minimal, nextjs, hono-api, bun-api, bun-fullstack, nextjs-monorepo, bun-monorepo, enterprise-monorepo
- shadcn/ui integration with 5 modern styles (radix-maia, radix-vega, radix-nova, radix-lyra, radix-mira)
- Database setup: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite with Drizzle ORM or Prisma, Supabase integration
- Authentication: better-auth, NextAuth.js, or Supabase Auth
- DevOps: Docker multi-stage builds, GitHub Actions CI/CD

Tech stack: Bun 1.3+, Next.js 16, React 19, Hono 4, TypeScript 5.9+, Tailwind CSS 4, Radix UI/Base UI, Phosphor/Iconoir icons.

## Source Code

- [CLI Package](https://github.com/Arakiss/bunkit/tree/main/packages/cli): Main CLI implementation with commands
- [Core Package](https://github.com/Arakiss/bunkit/tree/main/packages/core): Shared types, utilities, and PresetRegistry
- [Templates Package](https://github.com/Arakiss/bunkit/tree/main/packages/templates): Project generators and builders
- [Generators Package](https://github.com/Arakiss/bunkit/tree/main/packages/generators): Code generators for specific features

## Key Files

- [PresetRegistry](https://github.com/Arakiss/bunkit/blob/main/packages/core/src/presets/registry.ts): Single source of truth for preset metadata and dependency catalogs
- [Init Command](https://github.com/Arakiss/bunkit/blob/main/packages/cli/src/commands/init.enhanced.ts): Interactive project creation with 21+ prompts
- [UI Package Builder](https://github.com/Arakiss/bunkit/blob/main/packages/templates/src/shared/ui-package.ts): shadcn/ui package generation with modern CSS
- [Theme Generator](https://github.com/Arakiss/bunkit/blob/main/packages/templates/src/generators/shadcn-themes.ts): CSS theme generation for all shadcn/ui styles
